name: melee_ally_in_the_way
about: A melee NPC whose way to the enemy is blocked by an ally circles instead of advancing through it. Two bat-only TutorialThug humans (npc_VHumanCombatant, item_w_baseball_bat, D_HT 5 to the player, no relationship to each other: neutral) stand before the player: arena_front 200 cm in front of the player and 50 cm to the side of the line, arena_rear on the line 250 cm behind it, both facing the player. CNPC_VHuman::SelectScheduleMeleeCombat 0x10385e40 (slot 604; bat-only, so the _NR forms: slot 308 HasUsableRangedWeapon 0x10336d70 is false) asks 0x102a11d0 before it advances: a swept slab (the hull's mins/maxs doubled in X/Y, Z +-6, mask 0x2000000) from WorldSpaceCenter to the enemy, true when the nearest body met is an NPC this one does not hate (IRelationType != D_HT). The 50 cm is the statement (a record error corrected by the V11 integrator, measured): with arena_front exactly ON the line, slot 331 ChooseMeleeAttackSequence 0x10347180's line gate (a zero-extent trace between the two slot-192 centres, 0x1034727b) hits it and raises COND_ENEMY_BLOCKED 0x3a (0x103472f2), and the selector's failure gate 0x102b6fe0 answers 0xce SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ADVANCE_NR_LKP_NOSEE (AI_BaseNPCTroika.cpp:23169) BEFORE 0x102a11d0 is asked -- retail's own order (trace: cond+ ENEMY_BLOCKED at 0.600, schedule 0xce). 0x102a11d0 decides for an ally the centre line misses and the doubled hull meets: the HUMAN_HULL is 13 units (33 cm) to a side, so at 50 cm the line passes 17 cm clear of arena_front's box and the 26-unit (66 cm) slab overlaps it. With arena_front between, arena_rear's answer is the circle pair, 0xe1 SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_CIRCLE_ADVANCE_NR, never 0xcb SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ADVANCE_NR And arena_front's swings never reach arena_rear: MeleeSwingStep 0x10343020's relation filter (0x1034394d) skips a character the NPC attacker neither hates nor fears. (stories/v4/packets-S2.md, 0x102a11d0; packets-S3.md item 8; stories/v1/triage.md, Judge's rulings, V4 -- second sitting, J10).
notes: The schedules are matched by their class-local number (0xe1, 0xcb), not by name: if the trace prints another name for either, the number still decides (brief A0 item 7). The `never` on 0xcb closes at 8 s: arena_front is 200 cm (79 units) from the player and advances to swing, after which it no longer stands between and a plain advance by arena_rear is retail.
